messages:
Mara: quick ask for runtime: we need a very small, focused rerun for launch comms. 3 checks: 1) sample drift vs our earlier bench (same seed set), 2) quantized vs float baseline delta for cold-start p50/p95, 3) smoke for long-tail prompts (>1k tokens). can you run a lightweight pack and share the raw lat/bytes CSV and a 1-paragraph callout we can paste into the launch PR?

Jesse: sounds doable — thanks for flagging. what exact model variants do you want included? quantized recipe name? and what's the max timebox for the run? :)

Mara: thanks. include: redwood-7b-quantized-v2 and redwood-7b-fp16. quantized recipe = q4_0-opt (same as marketing bench doc). timebox = 4h cap, but prioritize a smoke of 200 random samples first so we can get numbers for the deck today.

Liam: I can spin a staging job for the 200-sample smoke. do we want warmup per host (2 warmup requests) or no warmup to measure cold-starts? also prefer to run both "cold" and "warmed" slices so marketing can claim both numbers.

Mara: both slices please. we want cold-start p50/p95 and warmed p50/p95. for warmed, do 5-request warmup per host. label outputs: "cold" and "warmed".

Anya: will attach the exact seed list. using the sheet I maintain — link: https://redwood.app/sheets/bench-seeds-2026 — seeds column "launch_marketing_v1". I'll export as CSV and drop in the artifacts folder when done.

Jesse: perfect. one more: do you need token-level cost breakdown or just latency and bytes?

Mara: primarily latency (p50/p95), tokens generated, and RPS. a small cost delta line (approx $/k tokens) would be helpful but optional.

Liam: ok i'm queueing a 200-sample smoke against both variants now. will run cold first (no warmup), then warmed. plan: 2 concurrent hosts, batch size tuned to production warmup. using script `./bench/smoke_launch.sh --seeds seeds.csv --model {variant} --samples 200`. posting logs here.

deploy-bot: scheduled run triggered: job id run_2026_348000. approximate ETA for smoke results 18 minutes. :rocket:

Jesse: if smoke looks sane i'll schedule the 2k sample background sweep (best-effort, may exceed the 4h cap). Mara — do you want the 2k sweep too or hold until we confirm smoke?

Mara: hold on 2k until smoke ✅. if smoke has unexpected deltas (quantized >10% p95 regression) then pause and we will iterate on warmup or batch config.

Liam: smoke done — quick paste of initial numbers (warmed first):

```
redwood-7b-fp16 warmed p50=45ms p95=120ms tokens=320 avg_rps=90
redwood-7b-q4_0-opt warmed p50=48ms p95=135ms tokens=318 avg_rps=92
redwood-7b-fp16 cold p50=110ms p95=420ms
redwood-7b-q4_0-opt cold p50=125ms p95=520ms
```

Anya: CSV upload: gs://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-sanity/3480001234/smoke_results.csv (seeds column included).

Jesse: numbers look reasonable for marketing copy. quantized p95 cold ~24% higher — within expected for q4 recipe. i'll add a one-paragraph note and a short bullets list of methodology (200-sample smoke, seeds from sheet, cold/warmed, run on staging dedicated hosts). will post in 15m.

Mara: amazing — please include the exact command you ran and the minimal caveats (small sample, staging, dedicated cpu/gpu diff) so we don't overclaim. once i have your paragraph i can finalize the launch blurb and one-slide chart. :pray:
